import sys
import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime, timezone, timedelta


def get_local_tz_name():
    try:
        with open("/etc/timezone", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            name = f.read().strip()
            if name:
                return name
    except Exception:
        pass
    return None


def main():
    # --- Determine "next Monday" (the coming Monday; if today is Monday, one week out) ---
    today = date.today()
    days_until_monday = (7 - today.weekday()) % 7
    if days_until_monday == 0:
        days_until_monday = 7
    kickoff_date = today + timedelta(days=days_until_monday)

    iana = get_local_tz_name()
    tz_display = iana if iana else "local time (UTC assumed)"

    try:
        from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

        tz = ZoneInfo(iana) if iana else timezone.utc
    except Exception:
        tz = timezone.utc

    start_local = datetime(
        kickoff_date.year, kickoff_date.month, kickoff_date.day, 10, 0, tzinfo=tz
    )
    end_local = start_local + timedelta(hours=2)

    # --- Build the ICS content ---
    try:
        from icalendar import Alarm, Calendar, Event

        cal = Calendar()
        cal.add("prodid", "-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN")
        cal.add("version", "2.0")
        cal.add("calscale", "GREGORIAN")

        event = Event()
        event.add("summary", "Project Kickoff Meeting")
        event.add(
            "description",
            "Project kickoff meeting to align on scope, goals, roles, and timeline.",
        )
        event.add("dtstart", start_local)
        event.add("dtend", end_local)
        event.add("dtstamp", datetime.now(timezone.utc))
        event.add("uid", f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar.local")
        event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
        event.add("sequence", 0)

        alarm = Alarm()
        alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
        alarm.add("description", "Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes")
        alarm.add("trigger", timedelta(minutes=-15))
        event.add_component(alarm)

        cal.add_component(event)
        ics_bytes = cal.to_ical()
    except Exception:
        # Fallback: manual ICS with UTC timestamps
        start_utc = start_local.astimezone(timezone.utc)
        end_utc = end_local.astimezone(timezone.utc)
        uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar.local"
        dtstamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
        ics = (
            "BEGIN:VCALENDAR\r\n"
            "VERSION:2.0\r\n"
            "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN\r\n"
            "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN\r\n"
            "BEGIN:VEVENT\r\n"
            f"UID:{uid}\r\n"
            f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}\r\n"
            f"DTSTART:{start_utc.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}\r\n"
            f"DTEND:{end_utc.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}\r\n"
            "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting\r\n"
            "DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting to align on scope, goals, roles, and timeline.\r\n"
            "STATUS:CONFIRMED\r\n"
            "SEQUENCE:0\r\n"
            "BEGIN:VALARM\r\n"
            "ACTION:DISPLAY\r\n"
            "DESCRIPTION:Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes\r\n"
            "TRIGGER:-PT15M\r\n"
            "END:VALARM\r\n"
            "END:VEVENT\r\n"
            "END:VCALENDAR\r\n"
        )
        ics_bytes = ics.encode("utf-8")

    out_path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "kickoff.ics"
    with open(out_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(ics_bytes)

    # --- Validate ---
    validation = "not machine-validated (icalendar not installed)"
    try:
        from icalendar import Calendar as IC

        IC.from_ical(ics_bytes)
        validation = "VALID"
    except ImportError:
        pass

    print("=== Calendar entry created ===")
    print(f"Summary  : Project Kickoff Meeting")
    print(f"Date     : {kickoff_date.isoformat()} (next Monday)")
    print(f"Start    : 10:00 AM {tz_display}")
    print(f"End      : 12:00 PM {tz_display}")
    print(f"Duration : 2 hours")
    print(f"Reminder : 15 minutes before")
    print(f"File     : {out_path}")
    print(f"Validation: {validation}")
    print()
    print(ics_bytes.decode("utf-8"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
